— Site information

Privacy policy

How this website is configured to handle inquiries, optional measurement, browser preferences, and third-party services.

Review required before launch

This notice describes this website build. The owner must confirm the responsible contact, deployment regions, applicable law, provider arrangements, and any additional legal obligations before public launch.

Who this website represents

This is the personal professional website of Shahir Salehi at shahirsalehi.com. A responsible privacy contact and any legally required operator details must be supplied before launch. No physical address or service territory has been assumed.

Reading the website

Standard page content is delivered as static files. This build does not require an account or a database. When hosted, the hosting provider processes connection and request information needed to serve the site and operate its service. The owner must review the selected Cloudflare service terms, logging configuration, retention, and relevant processing arrangements.

Inquiries

The contact submission endpoint is not configured in this build, and the send button is disabled. No inquiry is sent or stored by this site. The fields are not saved in browser storage. Before enabling submissions, this notice must identify the actual provider, purposes, recipients, retention, and a working contact method.

Optional measurement and advertising

Tracking identifiers are unset by default. No optional analytics or advertising script loads until it is configured and the relevant consent has been given. Analytics and marketing are separate categories. Personal form contents are not included in website analytics events. If tracking is enabled, this notice must be updated to name the actual services, data, purposes, retention, and applicable transfer arrangements.

Browser preferences

The site stores optional consent choices in localStorage under ss-consent-v1, with a six-month expiry. This records the choice and timestamp, not form contents. You can change the setting through Privacy preferences in the footer or remove it using browser controls. The site remains readable if this storage is unavailable.

Your choices and requests

You can decline optional tracking and continue using the site. Browser and blocker settings may also restrict collection. Rights and legal bases depend on applicable law and actual processing; the owner must establish a usable request channel and review obligations before launch. Do not submit sensitive information through a general inquiry form.

Changes to this notice

Review this notice whenever the hosting, form handling, tracking configuration, or business arrangements change. It must reflect the deployed system rather than a planned integration. No claim of automatic legal compliance is made.
